_comment: Canon law five: the heroes lose, and the tellers are why there is a story at all. The gods and monsters get sigils, which are geometry hashed from a name. The people get faces. Each caption names what this person DID, because that is the only reason they are in the anthology.

witnesses.name: Feeriko
witnesses.did: Talked a serpent out of giving up, for a full momenta, because the deal was that if she stopped, he would stop.

witnesses.name: Tveggi
witnesses.did: Could not hear names being eaten, so she was the only one who could keep the count. Then she worked out that a name does not have to be a sound, and cut a mark.

witnesses.name: Sœbra
witnesses.did: Wrote the terms down on wet bark in a hurry. The bark burned that night. They put her in the pantheon anyway, over the priesthood's objections.

witnesses.name: Sœlvi
witnesses.did: Became the first Marltain who was one, found the grammar had no way to say it, and invented the act of addressing someone who is not there.

witnesses.name: Ædri
witnesses.did: Kept the first ledger of cold-holds. It is still public, it is still updated, and it is still not a small number.

witnesses.name: Hild-Ronn
witnesses.did: Worked out that the line did not need power, it needed occupancy. Then she dug the first shaft and put her own mother in it, standing up.

witnesses.name: The Cendran child
witnesses.did: Was handed a stylus on the morning after everything burned and asked for one thing nobody had ever written down. Wrote the fourteenth's name.

witnesses.name: Ilta
witnesses.did: Walked around to the other side. Described in every telling as unremarkable, and in most as slightly annoying.

witnesses.name: Ossul
witnesses.did: Quietly failed to action four correction requests for twenty-two galaxals, because the safest place for a number is a queue nobody reads.

witnesses.name: Hallovar
witnesses.did: Announced the hour he would stop, then spent three hundred clicks teaching them to do his job. He did not finish lesson three hundred and forty one.
